_comment: CR-036 S13 prep (written by slice S12): the fake-based suite of every native access-control screen of stage 1 - the WisKey native screens S0-S12. Nothing in it contacts a WisKey, Home Assistant, station or device: the backend tests run against smplwise_vms/backend/tests/fake_wiskey.py, the browser specs against mocked backends (frontend/tests/access-control-mocks.ts, access-parity-mocks.ts, wiskey-stations-mocks.ts, wiskey-people-mock.ts). Test catalogue entry: AT317. Paths are relative to the repository root. The runner commands follow private/runner/run_smart_README_HE.md (the branch must be pushed; jobs queue behind a running gate - wait, never kill).

backend.runner: python private/runner/run_smart.py backend <branch> <the tests above, as parallel shards>

runner.spec: python private/runner/run_smart.py spec <branch> <unit + evidence + layout files> --workers=1 (dev server) and preview <branch> <the same> (built dist)
runner.pixel: python private/runner/run_smart.py linux-pixel <branch> <pixel files> --project=desktop --project=mobile [--update-snapshots, then look at every image, commit, run again without it]

after_merge_of.pilot/WISKEY-native-s11-writes: its own backend tests and specs (the write gates) - add them here when it lands

not_in_this_suite.live_fixture: tests/evidence-wiskey-events.spec.ts and the old embedded-panel specs (evidence-wiskey-people / -editor / -capture / -credentials) need SW_LIVE=1 and frontend/tests/fixtures/wiskey_fake_ha.py, which serves only events/list, users/get, users/query of the 25 typed reads - the status page, event detail / picture / export, groups and schedules have never run end to end against the real backend (NOT_RUN; extending the fixture is an S13 item)
not_in_this_suite.live_device: anything against a real WisKey, Home Assistant or station: slice S14 with the owner
